## Q1
Arrange the following computers in chronological order:<br>
A. The Atanasoff Berry Computer (ABC)<br>
B. IBM-701<br>
C. The Mark I Computer<br>
D. UNIVAC I<br>
E. IBM-650<br>
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

## Q1 - Options
(A) C, D, A, E, B
(B) A, C, E, B, D
(C) A, C, E, D, B
(D) A, C, D, B, E

## Q1 - Hint
**Answer:** D
**Topic:** ICT (Computers, Internet, Terminology)
**Source:** UGC NET Jun 2026 (22 Jun, Shift 2) · Paper 1 · Q9

The correct history is ABC (1942) → Mark I (1944) → UNIVAC I (1951) → IBM 701 (1952) → IBM 650 (1953–54), i.e. A, C, D, B, E. The printed options 1–3 did not contain this sequence, so option D has been editorially corrected to 'A, C, D, B, E' and is the intended key.

## Q4
E-learning strategies are supported by:<br>
A. Virtual Classroom<br>
B. TCP/IP<br>
C. Instant messaging<br>
D. Satellite classroom<br>
E. Web casting<br>
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

## Q4 - Options
(A) A, B, C only
(B) C, D, E only
(C) A, C, E only
(D) A, D, C only

## Q4 - Hint
**Answer:** C
**Topic:** ICT (Computers, Internet, Terminology)
**Source:** UGC NET Jun 2026 (22 Jun, Shift 2) · Paper 1 · Q37

Virtual classrooms, instant messaging and web casting are instructional strategies for delivering e-learning. ## Q5
Match List-I with List-II.<br>
Choose the correct answer from the options:

| List-I (Concept) | List-II (Feature) |
|---|---|
| A. Algorithm<br>B. Modem<br>C. Bandwidth<br>D. Flowchart | I. Range of frequencies over which signals are transmitted<br>II. Converts digital signals to sine waves and vice-versa<br>III. Pictorial representation of a computational procedure<br>IV. Finite sequence to solve a problem |

## Q5 - Options
(A) A-IV, B-I, C-II, D-III
(B) A-IV, B-II, C-I, D-III
(C) A-II, B-IV, C-III, D-I

## Q5 - Hint
**Answer:** B
**Topic:** ICT (Computers, Internet, Terminology)
**Source:** UGC NET Jun 2026 (22 Jun, Shift 2) · Paper 1 · Q45

An algorithm is a finite sequence of steps to solve a problem (IV). A modem converts digital signals to analog (sine) waves and back (II). Bandwidth is the range of frequencies over which signals are transmitted (I). A flowchart is a pictorial representation of a computational procedure (III) — A-IV, B-II, C-I, D-III.

**Answer:** C

## Q11
Which is the correct sequence of increasing access time of storage/memory devices?

A. Magnetic tape<br>
B. RAM<br>
C. Cache memory<br>
D. Hard disk<br>
E. Registers

## Q11 - Options
(A) A, B, C, D, E
(B) B, E, C, A, D
(C) E, C, B, D, A
(D) C, E, B, A, D

## Q11 - Hint
**Answer:** C
**Topic:** ICT (Computers, Internet, Terminology)
**Source:** UGC NET Jun 2025 (26 Jun, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q12

Registers are fastest, followed by cache, RAM, hard disk, and magnetic tape. Thus the increasing access-time sequence is E, C, B, D, A. Therefore, E, C, B, D, A is the correct choice.

## Q12

## Q12 - Options

**Answer:** D
**Topic:** ICT (Computers, Internet, Terminology)

## Q20
Which statements about high-level computer programming languages are true?

A. They need translation into machine code to run on a computer.<br>
B. They are written using mnemonic codes.<br>
C. They are specific to the computer hardware.<br>
D. They are portable languages.

Choose the correct answer.

## Q20 - Options
(A) B and C only
(B) A and B only
(C) A and D only
(D) C and D only

## Q20 - Hint
**Answer:** C
**Topic:** ICT (Computers, Internet, Terminology)
**Source:** UGC NET Jan 2025 (6 Jan, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q40

High-level languages must be compiled or interpreted into machine-executable form and are largely portable across hardware. Mnemonic codes and machine dependence describe assembly language, not high-level languages.

## Q21
In computer networking, an IPv6 address is how many times larger than an IPv4 address?

## Q21 - Options
(A) 2
(B) 4
(C) 6
(D) 8

## Q21 - Hint
**Answer:** B
**Topic:** ICT (Computers, Internet, Terminology)
**Source:** UGC NET Aug 2024 (23 Aug, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q32

IPv4 uses 32 bits and IPv6 uses 128 bits. Since 128/32 = 4, an IPv6 address is four times as large in bit length.
